title: A New Chapter
overview: The Troopers travel to the Demon World to investigate a strange new barrier around Tokyo.

title: Miracle
overview: A shocking attack from the Divine World forces the Troopers to work with their demon enemies.

title: In Concert
overview: The Ten Warriors follow the Troopers to the Human World, but old grudges stand in the way of lasting teamwork.

title: Offense and Defense
overview: Shion confronts Ryusei about his new allegiance while the Divine World prepares a fresh assault.

title: Flash
overview: The Troopers corner Inmei, but even unexpected help may not be enough to overcome his schemes.

title: Comeback
overview: Gai steps up to bring the Troopers together after they lose one of their own.

title: Collapse
overview: The Troopers challenge the first of the Four Beast Warriors, only for his icy attacks to stop them cold.

title: Duty
overview: Sasuke must join the Troopers while his fellow warriors fight for the lives against a possessed Gai.

title: Warning
overview: The resurrected Ramaga seems unstoppable, even as Sagume and Inmei prepare their own secret weapons.

title: Love
overview: The Troopers find themselves trapped within Gai's psyche while Sagume duels a resurrected Ramaga.
